The value of pos at the time of copy equals buf.length (since the condition pos >= buf.length triggers the copy). Thus srcPos+length = buf.length = src.length, and destPos+length = pos <= new size, so indices are within bounds. Both arrays are char[], so no type mismatch. Therefore, under the given checks and validations, all exceptions are avoided.
